sentences.text:
This is second application under section 438 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with crime No.393/2022 registered at P.S. Pipalrawan, district Dewas for the offence punishable under sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the IPC on the ground that co- accused Sandeep Singh has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in M.Cr.No.
61484/2022.
2.
Counsel for the State submits that when the first application was withdrawn, the said bail order was available and despite that the application was withdrawn.

He further argues that co-accused Sandeep Singh has been granted bail on the condition that he agreed to deposit the alleged defalcated amount of Rs. 19,25,000/-.
3.

As per prosecution case, on 16.08.2022 a written complaint was lodged by the Branch Manager of Jila Sahkari Kendriya Bank Maryadit to the effect that on 16.08.2022 an investigating team was Ravi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168709333/
1 formed in the Bank as there was some financial mismatch in the accounts of the bank.

sentences.text: It was found that present applicant fraudulently deposited certain amount in the bank accounts of his relatives/known persons.

The total alleged misappropriated amount against the present applicant is Rs.1,01,24,785.89/-.
4.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration that all these arguments were available at the time of consideration of first anticipatory bail application, the co-accused Sandeep has been granted bail on the condition that he agreed to deposit the alleged amount under protest and allegation against the present applicant is misappropriation of a huge amount, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
